parameters: She and I were so alike, it was as if I were looking
into a mirror. She was born with the same eyes,
same hair, same figure as I.
This world doesn't need two of the same girl.
Seeing the screaming, bleeding me being dragged
into gears and crushed, I averted my eyes...
After being summoned by Good Witch Glinda, \c[2]The Black
Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young\c[0] took root in
that land, intending on ruling it and propagating.
And just like that, the Black Goat was cleanly caught
in the Lost Empire, manipulated by Mary Sue to be another
actor on the stage of her play.
\c[2]It's just, you know...
I wanted to see how mother would react when
she saw my very own tale.
It was such a let-down.\c[0]
Mary Sue's ability to change was a power unique to her.
Wielding it, she crafted and maintained many Gardens.
As vexing as it is, I'm obliged to admit her genius
as a Creator.
After Red and White Queens stripped Mary Sue of divinity,
after this unique power was stolen from her, they remade
'Ability to Change' itself into a new 'Great One', so that
neither of them could use it to trick another.
――The Theatre of Darkness, \c[2]Grand Guignol\c[0]\!
A mechanical god existing to be used by the selfish god.
Unexisting now, it exists in the distant past. In the
Winterbell Castle it sleeps together with the crown.
Born and dropped from a black and slimy womb, your child
crawled like a slug.
The White Queen views this Garden as nothing more than
a toybox and moves pieces only to fill for vacant actors.
Despite expending even newborns to prolong her worthless
drama of chasing love. In the end, she's a starwaste that
tumbled from the throne...She has no way of realizing
the charm of my jewel box, unrivaled in the whole galaxy.
Monster1
Hmm, it's so hard to pick with everyone being unique in
their own ways...and yet I must. This must be what they
call the writer's pain, isn't it?
...Right! I'll just mix and fuse them all together♪
Mary Sue possesses the Lost Empire, Elysium.
The Crawling One, Wonderland.
And every Great One has their own \c[2]'Garden'\c[0] they made.
The new Garden, reconstructed by gathering the great many
souls and sceneries discarded from those and piling them
all on top of one another in chaos...
This \c[2]"Chess World Shatranj"\c[0].
They mock my jewel box as "Chaos Dungeon". Can you not
understand how much more dazzling it is compared to your
worthless little Gardens? Isn't it funny how mimicking human
forms you embrace the emotion called jealousy without a worry?
EV 7は悪夢霊
